description:
About the company
 
 Our client is a healthcare technology company building AI-enabled medical imaging software. Its product engineering team connects clinical operations with reliable software and customer systems.
 
 The role
 
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join as a Software Engineer focused on Product to build internal tools and external integrations. The work is backend-oriented, with responsibility across the full product lifecycle and direct customer collaboration.
 
 What you'll do
 
 - Build internal applications for clinical case assignment, peer review, and business analytics.
 
 - Connect the platform with customer systems such as PACS, RIS, and EHRs.
 
 - Implement integrations using medical protocols including DICOM and HL7.
 
 - Work directly with customers during onboarding.
 
 - Identify workflow gaps and deliver product and operations automation.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 
 - 5+ years of product or software engineering experience.
 
 - Strong backend services, APIs, and data modeling skills.
 
 - Experience owning product work end to end in a small or autonomous team.
 
 - Ability to design integrations and reason through architecture tradeoffs.
 
 - Independent ownership of medium-to-large engineering projects.
 
 - Comfort working across the stack and directly with customer stakeholders.
 
 Bonus points
 
 - DICOM, HL7, PACS, RIS, or EHR integration experience.
 
 - TypeScript and React experience.
 
 - HIPAA or SOC 2 familiarity and a technical degree.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 
 - Base salary: USD 215,000 to 275,000 per year.
 
 - Equity: Competitive equity.
 
 Location and work model
 
 - San Francisco, California, United States.
 
 - Five days per week onsite.
 
 - Visa transfers and new visa sponsorships are supported.
